content: 帮我看看 OVS 网桥配置为什么没生效，先读取 ovs-vsctl show 的结果。

Bridge "br-klonet"
    Controller "ptcp:6654:127.0.0.1"
        is_connected: true
    fail_mode: secure
    Port "br-klonet"
        Interface "br-klonet"
            type: internal
    Port "vxlan-0"
        Interface "vxlan-0"
            type: vxlan
            options: {local_ip="10.0.0.1", remote_ip="10.0.0.2", key=flow}
    Port "patch-klonet"
        Interface "patch-klonet"
            type: patch
            options: {peer="patch-ovs"}
--- 以下为完整调试日志（合成超长输出，用于覆盖长工具结果轨迹） ---
2026-09-29T10:00:01Z ovs|00001|bridge|INFO|bridge br-klonet: created
2026-09-29T10:00:02Z ovs|00002|dpif|INFO|system@ovs-system: added port br-klonet
2026-09-29T10:00:03Z ovs|00003|vxlan|INFO|vxlan-0: tunnel remote 10.0.0.2 reachable
2026-09-29T10:00:04Z ovs|00004|ofproto|INFO|br-klonet: 2 flow tables installed
2026-09-29T10:00:05Z ovs|00005|connmgr|INFO|br-klonet<->controller: 1 controller connections
2026-09-29T10:00:06Z ovs|00006|memory|INFO|peak resident set size 128 MB
2026-09-29T10:00:07Z ovs|00007|rconn|INFO|controller connected after 3 attempts
2026-09-29T10:00:08Z ovs|00008|netflow|INFO|netflow exporter configured on 127.0.0.1:2055
2026-09-29T10:00:09Z ovs|00009|sflow|INFO|sflow agent initialized with sampling rate 1/64
2026-09-29T10:00:10Z ovs|00010|dpif|INFO|revalidator thread started
2026-09-29T10:00:11Z ovs|00011|ofproto|INFO|flow replayed for port vxlan-0
2026-09-29T10:00:12Z ovs|00012|ofproto|INFO|flow replayed for port patch-klonet
2026-09-29T10:00:13Z ovs|00013|bond|INFO|no bonds configured
2026-09-29T10:00:14Z ovs|00014|mirror|INFO|no mirrors configured
2026-09-29T10:00:15Z ovs|00015|netdev|INFO|ethtool stats refreshed for br-klonet
2026-09-29T10:00:16Z ovs|00016|netdev|INFO|ethtool stats refreshed for vxlan-0
2026-09-29T10:00:17Z ovs|00017|dpif|INFO|megaflow cache size 512 entries
2026-09-29T10:00:18Z ovs|00018|dpif|INFO|upcall handler attached to cpu 0
2026-09-29T10:00:19Z ovs|00019|dpif|INFO|upcall handler attached to cpu 1
2026-09-29T10:00:20Z ovs|00020|bridge|INFO|br-klonet: stp disabled, rstp disabled
从输出看 br-klonet 网桥已创建且 controller 已连接，vxlan-0 隧道指向 10.0.0.2。接下来需要核对流表是否下发到 patch 口，建议运行 ovs-ofctl dump-flows br-klonet 再确认。
